observations.name: “Touch”，再生之流
observations.location: Rank II/III talents, Absorb Infusion trigger; rendered lines 742–752 and 995/1176 in the captured web view
observations.excerpt: 若未能成功触发技能，则立即触发一次与技能所述相同的效果
observations.summary: 当关联召唤物获得自缚后，Touch尝试以该单位为目标强制触发吸收灌注。若未能发动，立即执行一次同样效果。页面另说明已开始的吸收灌注因中断或丢失目标结束时也执行后继，但这是结束而非启动拒绝。
observations.evidenceClassification: A real success/failure-dependent fallback is described. The page does not distinguish different start failure reasons.

observations.name: 噪鳞
observations.summary: 每0.1秒尝试受制约的强制技能跃出；页面明确受某种无法行动/无敌/不可阻挡状态影响时，跃出尝试始终失败。受限状态具体名称本次未核对。
observations.evidenceClassification: A real repeated attempt exists. No page evidence that retry interval or continuation differs by failure reason.

observations.name: 梅尔
observations.summary: 本体技能通过触发机械水獭自己的技能实现爆破回收；召唤物技能不能触发时不产生该效果。
observations.evidenceClassification: A real attempted secondary Skill can fail without effect. The remark does not require classifying its start failure reasons.

observations.name: 麦哲伦
observations.summary: 本体技能结束时的无人机回收通过触发召唤物技能执行；不能触发该技能时不产生回收效果。
observations.evidenceClassification: Same success/failure boundary; no reported different continuation per start failure reason.

observations.name: 断罪者
observations.location: 创世纪 skill description and remarks
observations.summary: 技能触发时抽取概率决定敌方伤害沉默或友方晕眩。页面称作失败的概率分支发生在技能已触发后的内容程序中。
observations.evidenceClassification: Not evidence for Skill/Action start rejection or its reason code.

observations.name: 乌有
observations.summary: 在场周期支付部署费用，无法支付时自动撤退。
observations.evidenceClassification: A resource-payment condition during existing participation, not a Skill/Action start failure-reason branch.

observations.name: “宝箱”
observations.summary: 技能已开启后的召唤可能因出生地块或路线安全条件失败，相关召唤后续不处理。
observations.evidenceClassification: A spawn-operation failure, not Skill activation rejection. The page does not show caller branching by multiple spawn failure reasons either.

result.conclusionLimit: No such reason-specific content was identified in these targeted examples; this does not prove that none exists anywhere.
